decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the core offer of a growing firm. With no sign of a shortfall against aspirations and with slack from industry growth, management has no trigger for problemistic search.

The numbering software module was actively promoted at launch and supports the firm's digitalization and serialization strategy. It ties up few resources, so a growing firm with slack has little reason to drop it.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the established inkjet and ink expertise into adjacent applications. With satisfactory growth and no evidence of underperformance, it stays on the market.
